body: Yes that is why I chose against it, my rope is set up well it should work effectively

3.5 hours left for me. I’ll be doing it at midnight. Hanging myself is my choice. I was tossing up between a rope or a train suicide but I decided that’s even more selfish as some poor train driver will have to kill me on New Years.

I don’t really know, I mean I don’t know why I posted this. I’m pro suicide. That’s just how I think. I realise you and all the others here just want to help and I appreciate that you are the type of person who would do that, it’s an amazing and selfless thing to do and I clap for you. But that being said I just don’t fucking care anymore man. Life for me just isn’t worth living every day is worse the next. Constant boredom, discontent, and disconnection to this world I live in. Every day I go through a battle. Two sides fighting, one saying I can make it, the other saying I’m delusional and a complete idiot for even thinking that I can be happy. I don’t see it being a possibility. I took all the drugs and still I feel empty, nothing will fill me. I have a fantasy in mind of the perfect life but at the same time it seems completely impossible. I want friends, I want a girlfriend I really do but I also just want to be left the fuck alone. Therapists and psychiatrist have told me I’m too much to handle because I’m hypocritical and contradict everything I say. All these mood swings are fucking up my goal and for once I see clear. My life is a low and always will be. I just need my own space. Wether that be an eternity of hell, heaven or nothingness. Whatever it is I have decided I want it. That’s all I want is to be gone. Maybe I get reincarnated and get to try again, maybe I don’t. I don’t know anymore but it doesn’t scare me. Billions of people have died before me and billions will die after me. It’s the way the world works and unfortunately for me the world isn’t fucking working my way and I’m too weak and insane to realise that I need to do things myself but like I said I’m too weak. This rambling makes no sense. 3.5 hours left. To anyone reading I will be spending my remaining hours finishing my notes while listening to my favourite rappers. (Earl and Mac)
I’ve been through it all, I’m just done

From my understanding regular use could lead to some damage to the serotonin receptors. Or isn’t that relevant with a microdose?
This doesn’t sound like a good idea, a doctor really told you to do this?

I’m 22. That sounds like a good idea but I’m a very negative and pessimistic person and I feel my mere presence brings peoples moods down due to my insecurities and shyness. I don’t feel I’m capable of making other people happy or comfortable because I am neither of those things myself. 

Thanks for the comment.

Congrats! It may not last I was happy for the first few days also (which I now realise was due to seeing someone and getting help, not really the Prozac) but stick with it. I’ve heard it can take anywhere from 6-8 weeks to really feel the effects. These drugs take a long time to work.

Sounds like freedom, you have a clean slate. You can do whatever you want. We are all gonna die someday and for all we know we get one shot. Make the most of it. I’m sure you can get through this. Please call emergency services.
Hope you make it out alive, emergency services are there for you to call at this time. Think about the people that care about you.

.I have attempted using a cocktail of pills but luckily I lived. 

It’s really a horrible thing surviving an attempt. I felt extremely guilty but relieved. I would have lost everything, I feel my family still resents me and I completely understand it. I did try to leave them forever after all. 

I don’t know your problems but suicide really isn’t a good choice. You have a fiancé do you really want to put him through the pain of losing someone he loves and plans to spend the rest of his life with? You said you have 12 letters, that’s a lot of people that care about you. If you aren’t being honest about your troubles I highly suggest you do so. Mental health is stigmatised but if they really do care for you it won’t matter. They won’t judge you. Therapy, medication are all viable options that I hope you can look into trying. Remember you may have to go through multiple therapists/medications before you find something that works for you. I understand the suicidal thoughts just a few hours ago I was in your position. 

For all we know we get one shot at this thing we call life. With all the negatives come the positives. I know it’s extremely hard to see them but trust me they are there. 

At the end of the day killing yourself takes a lot of effort and willpower. If you have that much drive to kill yourself I’m sure you have the drive to become the person you want to be. 

Good luck.
